title: Deleting the last of two purchases (10 at 100 and 8 at 140, average 117.777778): the reference system recomputes the average from the movements left and goes back to 100, and so does this application, which reverses the valued movement of the purchase at its recorded value (E58)

delete_and_restore.note: The second purchase deleted: it goes to the trash, its journal is erased, the stock goes back to 10 and the average goes back to 100.00; restored, it comes back with a new journal number and a new stock movement and the average is 117.777778 again
